method: node elimination from the PI rule of this degree with nodes allowed on the boundary (GPU Levenberg-Marquardt with annealing acceptance and node kicks, float32 search, float64 polish), unsymmetric, one node then moved 1.4e-6 outside the domain along the solution manifold so that the interval proof decides that the rule has a node outside (PO); checked numerically
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
